summary.text: Epstein files transparency: the Massie–Khanna discharge push for the Epstein Files Transparency Act, alongside Oversight's parallel investigation. Volume is very thin — four posts from three accounts across seven days, plus scattered retweets, so treat it as provisional. @RoKhanna opened on 8/31 framing the Massie partnership as rare bipartisan common ground, then on 9/1 warned Republicans may pressure Speaker Johnson to adjourn before the midterms. Two near-silent days followed, with press drifting to Maxwell's prison transfer. On 9/6 @RepRobertGarcia and @RobertGarcia entered on new ground: Leon Black skipping an Oversight subpoena and suing instead. Bipartisanship gave way to obstruction, but on one member, one day.
